context: First add diagnostic assertions or a reduced subprocess case that records normalized top/common/primary paths on Windows-shaped inputs. Prefer making the shell guard compare canonical Git-native paths and count worktrees/siblings consistently; if production behavior is already correct and only the fixture is malformed, repair the fixture. Add a simulated mixed-path regression so macOS can exercise the Windows normalization logic.
description: Nightly run 30690807993 fails three agent_write_preflight tests on both Windows versions: an undeclared plain clone is accepted, an ephemeral clone beside a pool is accepted, and refusal guidance is absent. The production guard passes its primary tests but the temporary clone fixtures cross the Git-for-Windows/MSYS path boundary. Diagnose whether git rev-parse, realpath, dirname/find, or environment inheritance makes top_abs differ from primary_abs or hides the sibling pool. Fix the narrowest boundary while preserving the load-bearing rule that BENCHBOX_EPHEMERAL_CLONE cannot disable protection wherever a pool exists.

anti_patterns.dont: Skip the safety tests on Windows
anti_patterns.instead: Normalize or faithfully simulate the path boundary and keep the assertions.
anti_patterns.why: The guard is used by cross-platform agents and the Windows failures show a possible fail-open path.

anti_patterns.dont: Trust BENCHBOX_EPHEMERAL_CLONE without checking for a pool
anti_patterns.instead: Retain both the single-worktree and zero-pool predicates.
anti_patterns.why: That turns the narrow disposable-clone declaration into a blanket bypass.

preserves.behavior: BENCHBOX_EPHEMERAL_CLONE=1 is honored only for a disposable clone with one worktree and no pool siblings.
